excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_MISSING: load-stage (config.py): reports the config file's absence; a document invariant needs a document to validate, and no schema can reject a file that is not there
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_UNREADABLE: parse-stage (config.py): file present but not valid JSON; the text never becomes a document either the schema or the native validator could see
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_MALFORMED_SHAPE: pre-validation type-shape guard (config.py) so a wrong-shaped JSON document surfaces as a finding instead of an unhandled Python exception; emitted by the loader, not validation.py, whose FINDING_CODES the invariants list above is pinned to by the conformance completeness test
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: load-time version gate (config.py): rejects documents from a different contract version before this version's invariants are applicable to them
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_FIELD: loader strictness against unknown/typo'd fields (config.py), asserted by the loader's own unit tests; emitted outside validation.py's pinned FINDING_CODES - the schema's additionalProperties covers the same contract for conformance purposes
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_MALFORMED_BINDING_ID: loader-side structural finding on binding_id shape (config.py), outside validation.py's pinned FINDING_CODES; asserted by the loader's own unit tests
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_BINDING_NOT_FOUND: runtime lookup miss (config.py): a caller-supplied binding id names no configured binding; CLI input resolution, not a property of the document
excluded_codes.E_CONFIG_LOCAL_ORIGIN_DISAGREEMENT: environment cross-check (config.py): compares the document against the live git checkout's origin remote; no document-only validator, schema or native, can assert it
excluded_codes.E_MAP_UNREADABLE: I/O failure reading the project map (compiler.py); reports the run's environment, not document content
excluded_codes.E_LEDGER: generic fallback code carried by ledger.py's LedgerError default finding (confirmed a real emission, not a bare prefix constant - see #348); reports a failed ledger operation, not a document invariant
excluded_codes.E_JUDGMENT_MALFORMED: ledger read-path guard (ledger.py): a persisted judgment event missing required fields or carrying a bad decision is skipped with this finding at reduce time; robustness against a corrupt ledger, distinct from the E_JUDGMENT_* document invariant validation.py owns
excluded_codes.E_REVIEW: generic fallback code carried by review.py's ReviewError default finding (confirmed a real emission, not a bare prefix constant - see #348); same shape as E_LEDGER
excluded_codes.E_CONFIRM_INVALID_DECISION: confirm CLI input validation (review.py): the operator-supplied decision value is not one of the accepted decisions
excluded_codes.E_CONFIRM_UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE: confirm-time lookup miss (review.py): the caller-supplied candidate key is named by no prior ledger event
excluded_codes.E_CONFIRM_INPUT_REQUIRED: confirm CLI argument validation (review.py): an edge decision was invoked without the required --input payload
excluded_codes.E_CONFIRM_KEY_MISMATCH: propose/confirm staleness signal (review.py): the operator-supplied candidate key disagrees with the freshly recomputed one; a check about two runs, not one document
excluded_codes.E_PROPOSAL_MALFORMED: in-flight proposal payload validation (proposals.py): the proposal is ephemeral tool input en route to a judgment, not a persisted graph document in the conformance corpus
excluded_codes.E_PROPOSAL_BASIS_INVALID: in-flight proposal payload validation (proposals.py): basis array rejected by the frozen canonicalizer before any key bytes are computed; tool input, not corpus
excluded_codes.E_PROPOSAL_UNKNOWN_ENDPOINT: requires the live compile preview (proposals.py): endpoint ids are resolved against the current graph, which no single-document validator can express
excluded_codes.E_PROPOSAL_ILLEGAL_ENDPOINT: requires the live compile preview (proposals.py): endpoint legality is judged against the relationship matrix and both endpoints' current class/kind, a cross-object check on the live graph
excluded_codes.E_PROPOSAL_ADVISORY_KEY_MISMATCH: propose-time staleness signal (proposals.py): a caller-supplied advisory key disagrees with the recomputed candidate key; a check about two runs, not one document
